class.name: NetwDatabase

method.name: batch
method.description: Returns a [NetwWriteBatch] that submits several writes and erasures in one call.

method.name: close
method.description: Stops accepting new operations and waits for the pending ones to finish. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the database is closed ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived the session that issued it [/codeblock]

method.name: delete_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot] and everything stored in it. The slot must not be open. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend removed the slot ┠╴ERR_BUSY slot is the one this database holds open ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database declares no backend ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived its session, or the backend │ implements no _delete_slot ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the backend's _delete_slot answered no promise ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not remove the slot [/codeblock]

method.name: erase
method.description: Removes the record at [param id]. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend acknowledged the erase ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 pending operations ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER │ id is empty ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the connection answered no outcome for the erase ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend or connection cannot perform the erase, or the │ database closed before it finished ┖╴backend-defined the backend rejected or could not complete the erase [/codeblock]

method.name: flush
method.description: Waits for every operation started before this call to finish. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK every earlier operation finished, whatever its result ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the session ended first, or this handle outlived it [/codeblock]

method.name: list_slots
method.description: Lists every slot the [NetwDatabaseBackend] holds. Works before [method open]. The promise gives a [Dictionary]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error check it before reading slots │ ┠╴OK listing succeeded │ ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend does not implement slot listing │ ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read its storage ┠╴detail String what went wrong, for a person to read. Empty when error is OK ┖╴slots PackedStringArray every slot the backend holds when error is OK [/codeblock]

method.name: open
method.description: Opens [param slot]. To switch slots, [method close] the open one first. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK slot is open, or was open already ┠╴ERR_BUSY another slot is open or opening, or the database is closing ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database declares no backend ┠╴ERR_CANT_CREATE the backend resolved no connection ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the backend's _open answered no promise ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived its session, or the backend implements │ no _open ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not open slot [/codeblock]

method.name: patch
method.description: Replaces the columns [param values] names in the existing record at [param id] and keeps the rest. [param values] may hold any subset of the columns in [param schema]. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend acknowledged the merged record, or values is empty ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open, or the schema declares no │ migration from the stored record's storage version ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 pending operations ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed, or no record is stored at id ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER │ id is empty ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA values names an undeclared column or a value its column │ refuses, or the stored record does not match the schema ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED │ the stored record is not in this library's format, or │ carries a newer storage version than the schema ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend or connection cannot perform the patch, or the │ database closed before it finished ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read or write the record [/codeblock]

method.name: read
method.description: Reads the record at [param id]. The promise gives a [Dictionary]. A record that was never saved gives [code]found[/code] [code]false[/code] and [code]error[/code] [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error @GlobalScope.Error. Check it before reading anything else ┠╴detail String what went wrong, for a person to read. Empty when error is OK ┠╴found bool whether a record was stored under id. False on any failure ┠╴id StringName the record id the read asked for ┖╴values Dictionary the stored row, keyed by column name, complete against the schema that read it. Empty unless found is true [/codeblock] [codeblock] var read: Dictionary = await db.read(PlayerSave.schema, account_id).wait() if read.error != OK: show_load_error(read.error) return if read.found: player.gold = read.values[&"gold"] [/codeblock]

method.name: scan
method.description: Reads one page of up to [param limit] records matching [param filter]. The promise gives a [Dictionary]. Pass the cursor it returns back as [param cursor] to read the next page. The scan is done when the returned cursor is empty. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error @GlobalScope.Error. Check it before reading records │ ┠╴OK the page was read │ ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED a record is not in this library's format, or carries │ │ a newer storage version than the schema │ ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA a record does not match the schema │ ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the schema declares no migration from a record's │ │ storage version │ ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived its session, or the connection │ │ implements no _scan │ ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read the page ┠╴detail String what went wrong, for a person to read. Empty when error is OK ┠╴records Array[Dictionary] each one shaped like a read reply ┖╴cursor String pass this back to scan to continue. Empty when no records remain [/codeblock] These fail the promise instead, and [method NetwPromise.wait] returns the code. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 pending operations ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER limit is below 1 ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the database closed before the page was read [/codeblock] [codeblock] var cursor := "" while true: var page: Dictionary = await db.scan(PlayerSave.schema, {}, cursor).wait() if page.error != OK: show_load_error(page.error) return for read in page.records: saves.append(read.values) if page.cursor.is_empty(): break cursor = page.cursor [/codeblock]

method.name: write
method.description: Replaces the whole record at [param id]. [param values] must hold every column [param schema] declares and nothing else. The promise gives an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend acknowledged the write ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER │ id is empty ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA values do not exactly match the schema ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend or connection cannot perform the write ┖╴backend-defined the backend rejected or could not complete the write [/codeblock] [codeblock] var error: Error = await db.write(PlayerSave.schema, account_id, { &"gold": player.gold, &"position": player.position, }).wait() [/codeblock]

members.member: Whether the session that created this handle still exists.
The name this database was declared under.
The open slot, or empty when this database is not open.
The state of the connection to the [NetwDatabaseBackend].

signal.name: failed
signal.description:
Emitted when an entity fails to load or save its record. [param error] is one of the codes [method NetwPersistenceHandle.load] and [method NetwPersistenceHandle.save] list, and [param detail] names the record and what went wrong. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.database(self, &"saves").failed.connect(show_save_error)
func show_save_error(_error: Error, detail: String) -> void: status.text = detail [/codeblock]
